title: Axoltly Garden - First Video!
author: axolotlgarden
selftext:
A couple of you asked to see it moving, so here's the first real footage of Axolotl Garden.

It's a cosy 3D game for Android, made in Godot. You look after axolotls and wake up an old sanctuary that's gone quiet, one habitat at a time. The pond waking up in the video is one of those. There are also races and other games at a stadium, and lots of different axolotl kinds to collect.

It's nowhere near finished and there's nothing to download yet. Everything in the video is from the game as it is today.

I'm honestly super proud of it. It's been a lot of late nights after work. Most of that time is spent talking to AI, which is still an odd thing to say out loud: going back and forth on ideas, reviewing what it's made, creating, and a lot of deliberating over small things until they feel right.

It's all AI built: Claude for the code, music and sounds, ChatGPT for concepts and art. The idea is my son's, and he's my harshest tester.

Happy to answer anything, and I'd love to know what stands out to you, good or bad.
